capabilityAnchor.description: Phase 14 reviewed-case validation, freezing, and public candidate projection

entry.offlineSmoke: uv run --offline --project agent --locked python -m py_compile agent/reviewed_cases.py agent/captured_evidence.py
entry.validate: uv run --offline --project agent --locked python agent/reviewed_cases.py validate --case "$PHASE22_REVIEWED_CASE" --bundle "$PHASE22_SOURCE_BUNDLE"
entry.freeze: uv run --offline --project agent --locked python agent/reviewed_cases.py freeze --case "$PHASE22_REVIEWED_CASE" --bundle "$PHASE22_SOURCE_BUNDLE" --output "$PHASE22_PRIVATE_ROOT/s1/frozen/denial.frozen.json"
entry.candidateInput: uv run --offline --project agent --locked python agent/reviewed_cases.py candidate-input --case "$PHASE22_PRIVATE_ROOT/s1/frozen/denial.frozen.json" --bundle "$PHASE22_SOURCE_BUNDLE" > "$PHASE22_PRIVATE_ROOT/s1/denial.candidate-task.json"
